Info.description: This project serves as a reference model for getting started with PX4-based multicopter development in Simulink®. It demonstrates Model-In-the-Loop (MIL) workflows and the deployment of perception and control algorithms for PX4-supported platforms. The example showcases how Simulink® can be used to model and simulate PX4 multicopter systems. The algorithms developed in this project can be directly deployed to PX4 hardware using the UAV Toolbox Support Package for PX4 Autopilots, enabling a streamlined path from simulation to production deployment.
